{{Otheruses|Alderaanian Expedition}}
The '''Twelfth Alderaanian Expedition''' was one of a series of expeditions that were carried out by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]]. The mission made contact with the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] descended from a group of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] colonists.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]</ref>
